displayIdentity.body: Knowledge, love, idols, and one God. Now about things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up. yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
displayIdentity.title: Knowledge, love, idols, and one God
